asmiṃś carācare vyakte krūre kena prakāśitā
tatprabhāvān mahādevi granthaṃ kartum iyeṣa saḥ
kṣāmā śaṅkāpi nīraṃ tadante proktaṃ śiṣyottama
jalaṃ bījāni proktāni ṣaḍ asatyānyaparāṇi ca
bījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyam ante jñeyaṃ nama iti
kūrcaṃ caiva maheśāni hyante phaṭ ṭha-dvayaṃ tathā
kūrcaṃ kūlaṃ taṭaṃ tīram asatyānyaparāṇi ca
phaṭ haraṃ turagaṃ cānyad asatyaṃ tu sureśvari
vāsanā paṅkajaṃ caiva vanaṃ proktaṃ tu śūlinā
ante stambhaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ śārikā-mūlam uttamam
bījaṃ ca ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharet
ebhiḥ saha manuḥ prokto rājñyāḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥ
etāsāṃ daśavidyānāṃ guṇān vakṣyāmi tvaṃ śṛṇu
śārikā śaṃ dadātyeva rājñī rājyaṃ prayacchati
dhanaṃ jvālāmukhī devī bhaktebhyaḥ sā prayacchati
iti śrīdakṣiṇāmūrti viracita uddhārakośe sarvāgamārṇave daśavidyā mantroddhārakośa guṇākhyānaṃ nāma prathamaḥ kalpaḥ
ṣaṭsakhīnām ahaṃ tāsāṃ mantroddhāraṃ bravīmi te
turyā mūlamidaṃ proktaṃ svatantre śaṃbhunā smṛtam
ṛkṣaṃ bhaṃ tārakā jyotistārā bījāni pañca ca
anta ucchūna-bījaṃ ca phaṭ ṭhadvaya samāyutam
vajravairocanīye dve māye phaṭ svāhayā yute
dakṣiṇe kāliketyevam ante kālī trayaṃ punaḥ
bījaṃ pañcaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharet
gaṇeśvaryai tathā cānte viśvaṃ ca samudāhṛtam
kevalaṃ muktaye devi yat proktaṃ tacchubhaṃ smṛtam
paraṃ yat sūcitaṃ devi sadyo mukti pradaṃ smṛtam
lakṣmīśca rukmiṇī caiva tribhirvarṣaiḥ phalaṃ labhet
bhedāste te tu vikhyātāḥ phalaṃ varṣacatuṣṭaye
dvivarṣamadhye bhaktyā ca rājñī rājyaṃ prayacchati
devyā dvādaśa bhedāstu proktā hyete triśūlinā
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hiṅgule tathaiva kamalā kṣāmāa tryakṣaṃ caṇḍike
hyaindri ? cāraṇameva hrīṃ ca madanaḥ kāmaṃ parā rukmiṇī
candro vāruṇi vā ka e ī la parā durge smṛtā śaṃbhunā
vidyā śrī viparīta bhāva sahitā syāt ṣoḍaśātmā vidhiḥ
bhedairyutānāṃ devīnāṃ manuṃ tvaṃ vaktum arhasi
dayayā tava deveśi tad vakṣyāmi samāsataḥ
vāgdevatāyāḥ phaladaṃ hi vālaṃ nṛṇāṃ namo bhaktiparāyaṇānām
tāraṃ lajjordhvabījaṃ ca hyante stambham udāhṛtam
tryakṣaṃ viśvaṃ tathānte ca parvateśvara nandini
parasparaṃ vai svakuleṣṭa devī mantrāṃśca vandyān śubhadān papracchuḥ
tasyāśca vadanāmbhojāt sapta devyaḥ śrutā mayā
prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe cedasmāsu dayā tava
sapta vidyāḥ purā proktā vajrayoginyādi devatāḥ
kulavāgīśvarī hyetāḥ sapta devyaḥ śrutā mayā
sa nirjitya ripūn sarvān kalyāṇī gṛham āviśet
ṛtu snātāyā bhāryāyā maithunaṃ kurute naraḥ
likhitvā dhārayen mūrdhni trailokya vijayī bhavet
anuvāde sa śatrūṇāṃ vākyajñaḥ sahasā bhavet
varāhamukhi caivaṃ tu vāsanā ca maṭhaṃ tathā
glauṃ bījoddhāram etaddhi cānyad anṛtam āvadet
bhagavatyai śāradāyai cānte lajjā ca ṭhadvayam
jṛmbanākhye tato devi kāmeśvari tathaiva ca
bījaṃ tu ṣaṭśiro jñeyaṃ viśvena saha bhāmini
ante ca vāsanābījaṃ padmaṃ kāṅkṣāpi nīrajam
vada me satvaraṃ devi tad vakṣyāmi suvistaram
kṛpayāpi purā mahyaṃ sūcitā na prakāśitāḥ
dakṣiṇāmūrtinoktaṃ yat tat te vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ
svayaṃ mayā ca tantroktā bhāṣitāḥ ṣaṭkumārakāḥ
madhye kumārāya namo hyante nīram udāhṛtam
śukrabījaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ kamalā rasanā tathā
ante payo manuḥ prokta ekaviṃśākṣaraḥ śive
hanumate tataḥ paścād rāmadūtāya vai punaḥ
vīṃ bījāni ca pañcaivam anṛtānyaparāṇi ca
dhruṃ bījānyevam aṣṭau ca kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca
ghnīṃ bījāni tu pañcaivam asatyānyaparāṇi ca
tasmācchaktiḥ khaṃ śarad dhṛjjatrāsau mantroddhāro devi mṛtyuṃjayasya
kālī padmau kūrca padmau samastā padmau nīram eṣa sugrīvamantraḥ
bījaṃ turyaśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharet
ṅa bījāni ca saptaivam asatyānyaparāṇi ca
vāsanā paṅkajaṃ caivam ante proktaṃ vanaṃ śive
kva rukmiṇī kva saubhāgyaṃ dyaubhuvorantaraṃ mahat
praṇavaṃ sakalā caiva deveśi rukmiṇī tathā
candro maṭhaṃ tataḥ paścād grahādhipataye tataḥ
caṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca
krūṃ bījāni ca catvāri kṛtrimāṇyaparāṇi ca
adyāhaṃ tava deveśi varṇānāṃ vacmi vai manūn
varṇānāṃ śrotum icchāmo mantra-kośāni vai vayam

candro'pi carmavasanaṃ vāsanā ca tathaiva ca

indrākṣyapi tṛtīyā ca tisro bhuvana devatāḥ
yasya kasya na vaktavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ varānane
mantraṃ ca dviśiro jñeyaṃ tataḥ pallavam uddharet
tathāpi sarvaduṣṭānāṃ vācaṃ mukhaṃ padaṃ tathā
tryakṣam ante payo jñeyaṃ dvipañcāśākṣaro manuḥ
prasthabījaṃ parāṃ padmāṃ carmāṇaṃ ca tato'bhidham
mlauṃ bījoddhāram etaddhi cānyad anṛtam āvadet
yām āśritya labhed yogī khecarīṃ siddhidāṃ kalām
tamobījaṃ tato dadyān māyābījaṃ tataḥ param
khecaryai ca tato dadyād ante sauṣmakam eva ca
nityaṃ lokatrayaika rakṣaṇaparāṃ tārāṃ trinetrāṃ bhaje
dhyāye'haṃ hṛdaye sadā bhagavatīṃ mātaṅginīṃ hāriṇīm
siṃhāsane sthāpita pādayugmāṃ jvālāmukhīṃ suhṛdaye smarāmi
svayaṃ mayā viracite tantre vai vāmakeśvare
nāhaṃ tṛptā vadantīṃ sakalajana cayaṃ bhakṣayantīṃ sadaiva
pāśāmbhojadharāṃ himāṃśu dhavalāṃ dorbhyāṃ dvibāhuṃ śivām
brahmā viṣṇu maheśvaraiśca namitāṃ devīṃ bhaje'haṃ turīm
bhakteṣṭāṃ chinnamastakāṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāye hṛdabje sadā
varṣāmegha nibhāṃ triśūla musalau padmāsi pāśāṅkuśān
devīṃ dakṣiṇakālikāṃ bhagavatīṃ raktāmbarāṃ tāṃ smare
mayā viracite devi tantre vai vāmakeśvare
siṃhāsanasthāṃ dhṛta pītavastrāṃ dhyāye maheśīṃ hṛdi kālarātrīm
sūryāgni candrīkṛta dṛṣṭi pātāṃ dhyāye hṛdabje vimalāṃ varāhīm
parvate sthitavatīṃ dhṛtaśūlāṃ śāradāṃ bhagavatīṃ hṛdi dhyāye
pītāmbarāṃ viṣṇu maheśa sevyāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ tāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi
candrodbhāsita śekharāṃ smitamukhīṃ dorbhyāṃ vahantīṃ gadām
gaurīṃ mānasa paṅkajāṃ bhagavatīṃ bhakteṣṭadāṃ tāṃ bhaje
niḥsmṛtaṃ bhairave tantre mayā devi prakāśite
eṇāsanasthāṃ bhujagopavītāṃ tām annapūrṇāṃ hṛdaye smarāmi
dvimṛgādhipa gāminaṃ trinetraṃ śivaputraṃ dviradānanaṃ bhaje'ham
nāgendra kanyā priyaputram ādyaṃ hṛdi smare'bhīṣṭapradaṃ kumāram
hastābjena sudhāṃśu koṭi vimalaṃ hāsyasya paṅkeruham
mbhojān bibhratam akṣayaṃ paśupatiṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ taṃ smare
sumeru śṛṅgābham acintyam ādyaṃ hṛdi smare'haṃ hanumantam īḍyam
acintyam ādyaṃ madhupāna saktaṃ hṛdi smare bhairavam iṣṭadaṃ tam
saptāśvagaṃ saddhvajahastam ādyaṃ devaṃ bhaje'haṃ mihiraṃ hṛdabje
yathā bhīṣṭa pradaṃ satyaṃ surāsura namaskṛte
krauṃcāsanaṃ ca sura sevita pādapadmaṃ śukraṃ smaredvijayanaṃ hṛdayāmbuje'ham
medhā nidhiṃ matsyagataṃ ? dvi-bāhuṃ guruṃ smare mānasapaṅkaje'ham
tamīpatim ambuja yugma hastaṃ dhyāye hṛdabje śaśinaṃ graheśam
surāsuraiḥ pūjita pādapadmaṃ bhaumaṃ dayāluṃ hṛdaye smarāmi
surāsurāṇāṃ bhayadaṃ dvibāhuṃ smare śaniṃ mānasapaṅkaje'ham
niḥsmṛtaṃ phaladaṃ nṛṇāṃ tantre vai vāmakeśvare
trailokya rakṣā param iṣṭadaṃ ca rāhuṃ grahendraṃ hṛdaye bhaje'ham
kṛṣṇāmbaraṃ śakti triśūlahastaṃ ketuṃ bhaje mānasapaṅkaje'ham
bhayadāṃ mahiṣottamāṅga saṃsthāṃ navadūrvā sadṛśīṃ bhaje bhavānīm
devīṃ śrībagalāmukhīṃ hṛdi bhaje bhakteṣṭadāṃ muktidām
niḥsmṛtaṃ jagad īśāni granthe vai rudrayāmale
indrākṣīṃ janamātaraṃ hṛdi bhaje kāruṇyarūpāṃ parām
yasya kasya na dātavyaṃ grantham uddhārakośakam
sapta kumāra nava graha catasṛ devī kośa dhyāna nirṇayo nāma saptamaḥ kalpaḥ
